sourceState: Audited working-tree changes relative to baseline; not represented as deployed or remotely tested changes.

findings.title: Expired early panel can renew review or route after scheduled resolution time
findings.description: submitPanelResult checked stored EarlyCheck state and signature validity, but did not independently enforce earlyStartedAt + earlyTtlSecs or scheduled time tau. A still-valid signed panel could route an expired check into EarlyReview and reset its review timer if no keeper had expired the check; it could also route after tau.
findings.impactBoundary: This is an early-resolution state-machine timing defect. The review did not demonstrate arbitrary finalization; committee and assertion requirements remain.
findings.repair: Reject the EarlyCheck route at either the early TTL deadline or scheduled resolution time, matching the existing early committee proposal deadline rules.

preFixReproduction.method: Added two deadline regressions against the original implementation before applying the guard.
preFixReproduction.failure: next call did not revert as expected

findings.fixtureRepairs: Two existing OracleGas early panel cases now warp inside their check TTL and before tau. Their shared setup previously left the clock after tau.

findings.title: Production size gate inherited oversized test-harness allowance
findings.description: The build size check inherited the ci profile code_size_limit of 1000000 bytes, intended for test harnesses, instead of enforcing the production Monad runtime limit.
findings.repair: Set FOUNDRY_CODE_SIZE_LIMIT=131072 only on the build and contract sizes step. Preserve the test step profile, harness allowance, fuzz count and invariant depth.

validation.isolation: Forge output and cache directories were isolated. No default oracle/out writes were performed by this reviewer.

oracleBeforeGasFixtureRepair.failureCause: Both existing early panel gas fixtures executed after their check TTL and scheduled time. Retained as intermediate evidence, not counted as a passing gate.

contractsFinal.qualification: This local result uses the risk profile, not the stronger ci profile.

riskSdk.environmentRepair: Installed the pinned local TypeScript dependency after the first invocation failed because it was absent. No SDK source change.
